title: Build Output Schema
description: Validates build phase completion and readiness for QA

all_micro_tasks_complete.description: All PRD micro-tasks have been implemented

all_tests_passing.description: All unit, integration, and acceptance tests pass

git_history_clean.description: Git log shows clear, logical commits aligned with tasks

drift_log_clear.description: No outstanding drift events or corrections in progress

no_open_blockers.description: No tasks marked as blocked or waiting for external input

deployment_ready.description: Code passes all linters, builds without errors, dependencies resolved

build_summary.description: Human-readable summary of what was built

known_limitations.description: Any deviations from PRD with rationale
